'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|My colleagues are asking for a favor, and strangely enough, they recommend you, mercenary. Apparently, I'm not the only one who's heard of your deeds. So here's the deal: you're going to eliminate the local leaders of all the primitive gangs that have set sails all over Tarkov. The details aren't important for you to know. As a reward, they say they'll leave a valuable souvenir for you. Now, go on, soldier. I'll be waiting for your return.}}

==Objectives==
* Locate and eliminate [[Reshala]] 15 times
* Locate and eliminate [[Glukhar]] 15 times
* Locate and eliminate [[Killa]] 15 times
* Locate and eliminate [[Shturman]] 15 times
* Locate and eliminate [[Sanitar]] 15 times
* Locate and eliminate [[Tagilla]] 15 times

==Rewards==
* +100,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Lightkeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.05'''</font>
{{quote|Excellent. Now, your souvenir is waiting for you at Ragman's place, he's already received instructions from our friends.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill each specified boss 15 times.
